title: 12 Best Athens Street Food Guide
description: Explore Athens' top 12 street food spots for 2026, from classic souvlaki and gyros to sweet loukoumades and savory pies. Discover local favorites, prices, and insider tips.

places.name: Kostas (Kolokotroni)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pork Souvlaki in pita with tomato, onion, parsley, and a touch of yogurt.

places.name: O Thanasis (Monastiraki)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Kebap portion (shish kebap) served with warm pita bread, fresh tomatoes, onions, and creamy tzatziki.

places.name: Lukumades
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Loukoumades with honey and walnuts (classic) or chocolate praline and crushed biscuit for a decadent twist.

places.name: Feyrouz
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The zesty Lahmacun with a squeeze of lemon and fresh yogurt, or a comforting spinach and cheese Peinirli.

places.name: Ariston
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The famous Tyropita Kourou: a rich feta filling encased in a wonderfully crispy, buttery crust.

places.name: Koulouri tou Psirri
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A simple, freshly baked koulouri, ideally still warm. Some vendors also offer cheese or chocolate-stuffed versions.

places.name: The Big Bad Wolf Souvlaki & Burger Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Big Bad Wolf' souvlaki wrap with their signature sauce, or one of their creative, juicy burgers.

places.name: Katsourbos
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A Graviera cheese pie (kalitsounia) or a traditional Dakos salad to go, featuring Cretan rusks with tomato and feta.

places.name: CrepaLand
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A savory crepe with ham, cheese, and mushrooms, or a classic sweet one with Nutella, banana, and biscuit crumbs.

places.name: Panormos
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Pork Gyro in pita – perfectly seasoned, tender meat carved fresh from the vertical rotisserie.

places.name: Pita Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Chicken Souvlaki or Pork Gyro in pita. They also offer excellent salads and sides if you're looking for something lighter.

places.name: Falafellas
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Classic Falafel in pita with all the fixings: hummus, tahini, fresh salad, and a touch of chili sauce if you like a kick.
